en: The First Book, The Chapter on the Antelope (Kuruṅgavagga)
7. The Abhiñña Jātaka “A mouthful is not enough to chew,
nor is it enough to form a ball, nor to gnaw on kusa grass.”
"I think that from seeing him so often,
the elephant developed affection for the dog.
Thus ends the seventh Jātaka, the Abhiñña-jātaka.
